description: Context rules for banking apps that handle regulated financial identity, account, payment, or transaction flows.

effect.appProfileImpact: For banking apps, exported auth, payment, transfer, redirect, WebView, or token-related activities are high-risk release blockers until caller validation, input validation, and intent/deep-link constraints are verified.
Banking services and receivers can trigger account, notification, sync, or payment-adjacent behavior. Unguarded exported entry points need to be fixed or explicitly justified before release.
Banking apps should not ship broad cleartext transport. Any exception must be domain-scoped, documented, and accepted in the app profile.
Banking apps may store identifiers, tokens, account state, or transaction context. Backup/data extraction behavior must be explicitly restricted before production.
Banking apps need stricter review of third-party SDKs because identifiers, telemetry, and account-context metadata can be regulated or contractually sensitive.
